race.description: Tabulam Cup 3 October Country Boosted Hcp (C1)
race.comment: REFEREES (1) lightly raced gelding who can go on with it this campaign. Motored late second up from back in the field with a solid third over 1200m at Moree. Has excellent second-up credentials and now in the Brett Dodson yard. Rates highly from the inside draw. STAR OF WINSTON (3) got the Maiden win out of the way two back, then launched late when he jumped sharply in trip to finish second over 1600m at this track in C1 company. Gets the right tempo again with the claim. Respect. PREDICT THE FUTURE (7) struggled to run out a solid 1600m when he dropped out in the straight to finish a dismal last at this track. Gets in light again with Palmer's claim and the drop in trip will help him return to form. Each way. RUSSIAN ESCAPE (5) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but looking for this trip at his third run back. Made up many lengths from near last on the turn to finish second over 1250m at Taree. Assess on the good Super Maiden win four starts back.
